name: Elenor Sawyer
source:
Elenor is a girl from a small village in the forest. Her father died a few years ago and she lives alone with her mother. She loved the stories her father used to tell her and together with her best friend Jack she keeps searching for a mysterious animal her father mentioned: The Silver Fox. She believes that this fox exists and hopes that it’ll grant her a wish. But one day she meets a new boy in the woods. Leon seems to know the forest even better than Elenor, but she has to make a decision… Can she trust him?

She is usually very polite and friendly but can be quite impulsive when someone’s teasing her. She is also very persistent as regards the search for the Silver Fox. Elenor doesn’t know yet what she wants to do in life; she’s not very good at sewing like her mother. Will she find her destiny?
